version.description: Policy version. Signed sessions bound to another version are refused.

blocked_apps.description: Regex, anchored to the start of a package/bundle-id segment. Agents may not act in or read these apps.

approval_apps.description: Every state-changing action in these apps needs approval.

risky_words.description: Whole words that make a gesture need approval (any language).

approval_auth.description: device_owner: approving also needs the human's biometric/password.

dry_run.description: Decide and audit, but don't ask for approval. Blocks still apply.

rules.description: First match wins. Rules may tighten anything; they never loosen a block.

id.description: Recorded on every decision this rule makes.

app.description: Regex on the app id, anchored to a segment start.

target.description: Regex on the target's text, label or id.

max_amount.description: Matches only when the amount is known and at most this.
